fields.validation: Every id resolves; relation is ACTION_DEPENDENCY, not evidence or proof; preserve independently declared accepted-knowledge dependencies

fields.name: external_prerequisites

fields.source_semantics: external_prerequisites plus explicitly bound additional requirement rules
fields.validation: Each tagged requirement bound to governing source; absence of positive evidence is an unsatisfied requirement, not missing definition

fields.name: knowledge_requirements
fields.provenance_requirement: Exact plan pin + selected ActionId + source member + typed binding identity; cross-source dependencies pinned individually
fields.validation: No fabricated knowledge identity/type; absent source member requires explicit normalization rule; provenance retains producer/outcome/source binding

fields.name: authority_requirements
fields.provenance_requirement: Exact plan pin + selected ActionId + source member + typed binding identity; cross-source dependencies pinned individually
fields.validation: Unknown/unbound rule rejects; empty allowed only by explicit no-outstanding-requirement binding; no grant inferred

fields.canonical_representation: sorted sets; exact object keys defined by ResultDeclaration
fields.name: result_contract
fields.provenance_requirement: Exact plan pin + selected ActionId + source member + typed binding identity; cross-source dependencies pinned individually
fields.source_semantics: Independent RESULT_BINDING citing acceptance_criteria and governing result contract
fields.validation: Possible outcomes/knowledge types and independently guarded root/slot transitions; no promised satisfaction

fields.identity_domain: CONTENT_IDENTITY plus separately tagged subject domains
fields.name: provenance
fields.provenance_requirement: Exact plan pin + selected ActionId + source member + typed binding identity; cross-source dependencies pinned individually
fields.source_semantics: BR-C1 source pins/selectors, context, governing evidence and rule references
fields.validation: Accepted binding, current source support, distinct definition/subject scope, full envelope identity domains; no accepting boolean as authority

identity.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON, sort object keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii=false; reject duplicate keys/nonfinite/floats; sort declared sets only; preserve ordered values; Unicode preserved without silent normalization
identity.no_identity_before_complete: Incomplete rows have null IR/profile identities; an input fingerprint is not an admitted identity

projection: Lossless field projection to the exact14 O01 definition keys; O01 whole-profile context/pins/independent expected definitions remain separately required. Single ActionIR cannot manufacture its own trusted O01 profile.

Provenance.context: accepted envelope/graph/ledger/policy/subject correspondence; typed absence retained
Provenance.selector: unique ActionId selector plus resolved JSON pointer

ResultDeclaration.knowledge_types: finite governed type set, possibly empty only by explicit rule
ResultDeclaration.outcomes: nonempty finite governed Outcome set; neither inferred from report presence nor from operation alone
ResultDeclaration.root_transition: UNCHANGED or separately bound proof-guarded transition declaration
ResultDeclaration.slot_transition: UNCHANGED or separately bound slot-admission declaration

TypedRequirementRef.domain: one allowed tagged requirement identity domain
